description: DTDL v2 schema for the gpio, watchdog, and thermalprotection MetricTypes documented in docs/Metrics/05_HARDWARE_FEATURE_FIELDS.md. All three are platform-dependent (e.g. Advantech SUSI). GPIO pinState supports v1.1 Explicit list / Auto-detect mode via Parameters.PinId / Parameters.PinIds; expanded sensors share the GpioPinState Telemetry DTMI and differentiate by ResourceId suffix at publish time. The reusable GpioPinLevel Enum maps the integer wire values 0/1 to the named labels Low/High.

schemas.description: Allowed MetricType discriminators in this Interface.
Allowed values of Parameters.MetricName when MetricType == 'gpio'. 'pinState' requires Parameters.PinId (v1.0) or Parameters.PinIds (v1.1) or auto-detect.
Allowed values of Parameters.MetricName when MetricType == 'watchdog'.
Allowed values of Parameters.MetricName when MetricType == 'thermalprotection'.
Logical level for a GPIO input pin. The agent emits the underlying integer value; consumer dashboards may resolve to the named label via this Enum.
Allowed values of SensorGroup. GPIO pinState uses 'DI'; capability flags (gpio.isSupported, watchdog.isSupported, thermalprotection.isSupported) use 'SYS'.
Allowed values of SensorInfo.Schema. For this Interface: 'boolean' for every *.isSupported, 'integer' for gpio.pinState.

contents.name: GpioIsSupported
contents.description: Whether the GPIO subsystem is present and responsive. MetricType=gpio, MetricName=isSupported.
contents.comment: Validation: stable per boot; v in {true, false}. A flip between samples on the same host indicates driver reload -- investigate. Use as a gate: if false, suppress alarms from any GpioPinState sensors on the same device.

contents.name: GpioPinState
contents.description: Logical level of one GPIO pin (0=Low, 1=High). MetricType=gpio, MetricName=pinState. v1.1 expansion: one published sample per Parameters.PinId (single) or Parameters.PinIds (array / auto-detect); ResourceId is suffixed with the pin name. Writing GPIO outputs is NOT supported in v1.x.
contents.comment: Validation: v in {0, 1}; any other value indicates a driver bug -- drop the sample. null/suppressed when PinId is missing on the sensor, when the pin name does not resolve, or when GpioIsSupported is false. See the GpioPinLevel Enum schema for the named-label mapping.

contents.name: WatchdogIsSupported
contents.description: Whether the platform exposes at least one hardware watchdog timer. MetricType=watchdog, MetricName=isSupported.
contents.comment: Validation: stable per boot; v in {true, false}. v == false on a unit that should support watchdog (per HwinfoMotherboardName) usually indicates a misloaded kernel module. Kicking the watchdog is NOT exposed in v1.x.

contents.name: ThermalProtectionIsSupported
contents.description: Whether the platform exposes the auto-shutdown / fan-curve engine. MetricType=thermalprotection, MetricName=isSupported.
contents.comment: Validation: stable per boot; v in {true, false}. SAFETY-RELEVANT: v == false means the host has no autonomous over-temperature response and the dashboard must be watched by an operator. Per-zone configuration is reserved for a future release.
